subject: Dedicated capacity recap — Orion Health
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@orion-health.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity recap — Orion Health

Hi Daniel,

Thanks again for the call today — great to meet the team and get a clear picture of your production needs. Below is a short recap so we’re aligned on scope, constraints, and next steps. Please flag anything I missed.

Summary of pain points / goals
- High and spiky realtime traffic from inference pipelines (peak 2500 qps).
- Need strict data isolation (PHI) and network control for ML infra.
- Predictable latency for synchronous endpoints (p99 targets for embedding and decode calls).
- Cost predictability for budgeting and procurement.

Proposed Dedicated capacity configuration (what we discussed)
- Reserved pool: 8x A100 80GB (single-tenant reserved capacity).
- Isolation: VPC peering + private control plane; option for customer-managed routing and private subnets.
- Autoscaling/burst: baseline 8 GPUs with automated burst to 12 GPUs for short peaks (policy-driven, per-hour caps).
- Model strategy: host two variants (production quantized model + higher-accuracy fallback) with automatic fallback on degradation.

SLA & performance targets
- Uptime SLA: 99.95% for Dedicated capacity (monthly).
- Latency targets: p50 ~40ms, p95 ~110ms, p99 <=200ms for decode requests under provisioned capacity.
- Observability: token-level cost and latency breakdowns, tracing hooks, and per-route dashboards.

Security & compliance notes
- SOC 2 evidence bundle available (summary attached).
- Logging and retention configurable; recommended 90-day application logs + 1 year audit logs for now.
- Key management options: Redwood-managed KMS or KMS integration (customer).

Next steps / asks
1) Ben (me) to send initial SOW + capacity plan and SOC 2 summary (attached).
2) Daniel to confirm target go-live window (you mentioned June timeframe) and preferred procurement contacts.
3) Schedule technical follow-up w/ Marissa (solutions engineering) to review network/VPC details.

Tentative timeline
- SOW delivery: today (attached).
- Legal + procurement review: 1-2 weeks after SOW receipt.
- Technical onboarding and testing: 2-3 weeks after contract execution.

Attachments (drafts):
- SOW_OrionHealth_Dedicated_v1.pdf (pdf)
- capacity_plan_orion.xlsx (spreadsheet)
- SOC2_evidence_summary.zip (archive)

If that looks right, I’ll queue an updated SOW with the pricing band we discussed and set up the technical deep-dive with Marissa next week.

Thanks,

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
